name: Angular Spectrum Method (ASM)
aliases: Helholtz equation solution in Fourier space
Helmholtz equation solution in Fourier space
definition: A free-space propagation operator used to model the parallel propagation of a wave field, resulting in a wavefront f(x, y; z).
summary: The Angular Spectrum Method is a free-space propagation operator that accurately reconstructs optical fields by solving the Helmholtz equation in the frequency domain without paraxial approximations.
